title: Composition of Conditional Expectations
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces, with strictly positive coordinate weights summing to $1$. For subsets $S,T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, a function $f$ on the product outcome space, and an outcome $x$, applying conditional expectation first over the coordinates outside $T$ and then over those outside $S$ gives the conditional expectation over the coordinates outside $S\cap T$: $E_S(E_Tf)(x)=E_{S\cap T}f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite product probability space
All coordinate weights are strictly positive and sum to $1
$S,T$ are subsets of the coordinate indices
$f$ is real-valued on the product outcome space
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$, $S,T\subseteq[n]$, $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$, and $x\in\Omega$. For coordinate conditional expectations, $E_S(E_Tf)(x)=E_{S\cap T}f(x)$.
